tests: Jobs API DELETE /api/v1/teams/:team_name/pipelines/:pipeline_name/jobs/:job_name/tasks/:step_name/cache deletes all matching step caches and preserves another job's cache
scenarios: Clearing a step without a path deletes both matching caches and preserves another job

tests: Jobs API DELETE /api/v1/teams/:team_name/pipelines/:pipeline_name/jobs/:job_name/tasks/:step_name/cache deletes only the selected cache path and preserves decoys
scenarios: Clearing one path deletes only that cache and preserves both decoys

tests: Jobs API DELETE /api/v1/teams/:team_name/pipelines/:pipeline_name/jobs/:job_name/tasks/:step_name/cache reports zero when no persisted cache matches
scenarios: Clearing an absent path reports zero removed caches

tests: Jobs API DELETE /api/v1/teams/:team_name/pipelines/:pipeline_name/jobs/:job_name/tasks/:step_name/cache reports zero for a missing step and preserves persisted caches
scenarios: Clearing an absent step reports zero and preserves all caches

tests: Jobs API DELETE /api/v1/teams/:team_name/pipelines/:pipeline_name/jobs/:job_name/tasks/:step_name/cache returns 404 for a missing configured job
scenarios: Clearing a cache for a missing configured job returns not found
